add.what: ahead() keeps only items whose due time is in the future; repeating items sit on their last, passed occurrence
add.meaning: Repeating reminders never show in the widget
add.impact: People see 'Nothing due' while their daily reminders are still coming.
add.trigger: A daily reminder after its first ring
add.fix: Use each repeating item's next occurrence, and add a test with a daily item.

add.what: Two phones editing the same item offline may keep the older edit
add.meaning: An edit made on one phone can be lost
add.impact: People may see an older version of an item they changed.
add.trigger: Edit the same item on two phones while both are offline, then reconnect
add.fix: Compare updatedAt before writing, and add a test for the race.
add.confirm: a run on two devices, or the Firestore load race test

dropReasons.speed:lists|src/components/WorkspaceChip: The list is capped at 5 chips, so drawing it whole costs nothing.

couldNot: Live Activity behaviour on a real iPhone
